data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental stag weekend itinerary 2027? You’ve come to the right place. A full-day charter from Puerto Banús is the ultimate way to celebrate with your mates — swimming in turquoise coves, cracking open beers, and cruising past superyachts. This guide gives you a concrete, hour-by-hour plan for a 8-hour charter on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with prices, stops, and tips to make it unforgettable.

Why a Boat Rental is Perfect for a Stag Weekend

Marbella’s coastline offers 27 km of sheltered waters, calm coves, and beach clubs accessible only by sea. A private boat gives your group total privacy — no crowded pools, no queues. You control the music, the drinks, and the itinerary. With a licensed skipper at the helm, you can focus on having a laugh. The Marbella boat rental scene is built for groups like yours.

Which Boat to Choose for a Stag Do

For a group of up to 11, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) are the best value. Both depart from Puerto Banús and cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day — all inclusive. If you have 12 lads, upgrade to the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. For smaller groups of 5, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is a budget-friendly option — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Full-Day Itinerary: 11:00 – 19:00

Here’s a sample itinerary that works well for stag groups. Your skipper can tweak it based on weather and your vibe.

  • 10:45 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your yacht, meet the skipper.
  • 11:00 – Depart. Head west towards the Sierra Blanca mountains. Open beers and cava as you cruise.
  • 11:45 – First swim stop at Cala del Faro (a small cove near the lighthouse). Water temp averages 22°C in summer.
  • 13:00 – Anchor near a chiringuito (e.g., Chiringuito El Caballo) for lunch. Bring your own or order fresh grilled fish and paella (approx. €25-40 per head).
  • 15:00 – Second swim at Cala Cortés or Río Verde. Snorkelling gear provided on request.
  • 17:00 – Cruise back towards Puerto Banús, past the Golden Mile mansions.
  • 18:30 – Dock at Puerto Banús. Optional: head to Pangea or Olivia’s for pre-club drinks.
  • 19:00 – Disembark.

What’s Included – No Hidden Costs

Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)✅

Jet ski (on Mangusta 80 only, 4h+)✅

Evening Options After the Charter

Once you’re back at Puerto Banús, the night is yours. Hit Opium Marbella for an outdoor club, or La Sala for dinner and cocktails. If you want to keep the sea vibe, book a table at Beachouse Marbella on the Golden Mile. Most clubs offer VIP bottle service for stag groups — ask your skipper for recommendations.

Booking Tips for a Stag Weekend in 2027

Book at least 3-4 weeks ahead for summer weekends (June-September). Deposit is typically 50%. We accept bank transfer or card. WhatsApp us for availability — we’ll confirm within 24 hours. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats or a larger vessel like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — pricing on request.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a full-day stag boat rental in Marbella cost?

A full-day (8h) charter on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 costs €2,299 for up to 11 guests. This includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and 21% VAT. Shorter 2-hour trips start at €749.

The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are popular choices for groups. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter.

What is a typical full-day itinerary for a stag boat rental?

A typical day: depart Puerto Banús at 11:00, cruise along the coast, swim at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, anchor for lunch at a beach club or chiringuito, then return around 19:00. The skipper can adjust the route to your preferences.

Are drinks and food included in the charter?

Yes, every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You can bring your own food or arrange catering with the skipper. Lunch at a beach restaurant is usually paid separately.

Can we bring our own music on board?

Absolutely. All our boats have Bluetooth speakers or AUX inputs. Just bring your playlist. The skipper will keep the volume at a respectful level for other boats and marine life.

What happens if the weather is bad on our stag weekend?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule to another day. The skipper makes the final call based on wind and sea state.

How do we book a boat for a stag weekend in Marbella?

Contact us via WhatsApp on our website. We’ll confirm availability, send a booking form, and take a deposit. The remaining balance is due on the day. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for summer weekends.
